name: almativa
description: Plataforma de gestao da Almativa - Pilates, Jiu-Jitsu e Fisioterapia

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @almativa/api" "npm run start -w @almativa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @almativa/shared && npm run build -w @almativa/api && npm run build -w @almativa/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @almativa/api && npm run test:web
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run infra:up && npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
